title: Kids’ Club PJ Party
seo_title: Kids' Club PJ Party at Fun Mountain, Nov 27
description: Kids' Club PJ Party is a Christmas-themed evening where children join Santa's elves for holiday adventure while parents can enjoy a night out at one of the award-winning dining locations. It takes place at the Kids' Nature Discovery Center at Fun Mountain on Friday, November 27, 2026, from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM.
venue: Kids’ Nature Discovery Center at Fun Mountain
